hypothesis: If the claim holds, in plaice the ratio k = W/L^3 will rise with length to a maximum near 30 cm and then decline slowly.
pass_criterion: Mean k by 1 cm length class has its maximum at a length between 25 and 35 cm, with k at the peak >= 5% above k at both the smallest (<15 cm) and largest (>45 cm) classes.
fail_criterion: k is flat (range < 3%), is monotonic, or peaks outside 20-40 cm.
interpretation: k is the Fulton condition factor, computed as W/L^3 in individual fish (the scaling constant is irrelevant). Plaice means Pleuronectes platessa. Size at maturity, about 30 cm, depends on sex and area, so the peak is compared with the survey's maturity data.

dataset.name: ICES DATRAS (Database of Trawl Surveys) - biological sampling (CA) data
dataset.publisher: International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES)
dataset.why_it_fits: Fields used: Valid_Aphia (plaice), LngtClass, IndWgt (individual weight), Maturity and Sex in the CA exchange data, for computing k by length class.
